questions: Should the x-axis ticks/labels for the line plot correspond to the original indices (0,1,2,...) or to the actual values of the data (if the data is a list of numbers, the index is just position)?
If the JSON data at the key path is a single number (not a list), should it be treated as a length-1 series, or should an error be raised?
Should the MinMaxScaler be fitted on the entire series (global min/max) or is there any per-segment normalization intended?
If the data contains NaN or infinite values, should they be removed, cause an error, or be handled by the scaler?
Should the plot be displayed (plt.show()) or just the Axes object returned without displaying?
If the data key path points to a nested dictionary instead of a list, should the function attempt to extract values from it or raise KeyError?
Should the function close any previous matplotlib figures or create a new figure each call?
